text:
anya: quick design note 1: found a couple of docs-console frictions and an a11y issue with the help drawer. dropping the surface-level points here so we can triage.

rachel: thanks. short bullets please so eng/docs can pick up.

anya: TL;DR:
- naming mismatch: console label shows 'model alias' but docs use 'pinned model'
- help CTA inconsistency: some places use 'Help', some 'View docs', no anchors or tracking
- help drawer a11y: ESC doesn't always close + missing aria-modal/role attributes

tom: agree on anchors. propose pattern: toasts and CTAs should link to /docs/{slug}#{section-id}?utm_source=console&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=help. That gives docs team context without extra payload.

jess: copy recommendations (short):
- inline tiny help: "A short note about X. Read more" (opens modal)
- external link CTA: "Open docs" (new tab, tracked)
- toast CTA for errors: "See troubleshooting steps" (anchor to section)
these map better to intent for users and analytics.

docs-bot: created mapping issue RED-3429 and attached a simple CSV template for console->doc term mapping.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist (concise):
- add role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" on the drawer
- ensure focus is set to the first interactive element inside the drawer on open
- ESC must call same close handler as close button and return focus to the help icon
- expose aria-labelledby to point to the drawer title

mike: small engineering note: add section ids to long pages we want to target (quantization, rollouts, caching). also please keep anchors stable (no auto-changing permalinks).

olivia: UX pattern note: inline docs panels should be one-sentence summaries + single CTA. reserve full how-tos for a modal that is explicitly labeled "Expanded docs" so screen readers know it's a heavy read.

rachel: naming question 1: do we standardize on 'Pinned model'? there are sdk examples that still reference alias. we need a migration path.

jess: vote for canonical term = 'Pinned model'. proposal: show label in console as "Pinned model (alias: <value>)" while SDKs get a deprecation note in the next minor release. add a short FAQ in docs.

anya: next steps I propose (short):
1) P0: a11y fix for drawer (role/aria + ESC behavior) 1 assign to eng-oncall
2) P1: canonicalize term to 'Pinned model' and create SDK deprecation plan 1 assign to docs + eng-sdk
3) P2: add anchor ids and UTM query pattern for console CTAs 1 assign to docs + eng
4) P3: standardize inline-summary + modal pattern in figma 1 assign to UX

docs-bot: updated RED-3429 with required fields: console_label, canonical_term, docs_slug, preferred_cta. ETA 2 business days.

anya: can UX/docs post the exact copy snippets and the Figma spec by EOD so eng can implement anchors and telemetry easily?

jess: will post copy variants here in ~2h.

mike: i'll add a minimal telemetry event for CTA clicks: {page, section_id, cta_type}. keep it small. also will add an e2e asserting ESC closes drawer and focus returns.

olivia: I'll produce the Figma frames for inline summary + modal behavior and add an a11y annotation for screen readers.

rachel: sounds good. i'll convert into tasks and link RED-3429. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
